description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log data and outputs it to a TextView, managing log levels, tags, messages, and exceptions, and supports chaining of LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display formatted log messages, supporting priorities, tags, exceptions, and chaining to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, on the UI thread. Also passes the log message to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
